Name: CommandCheckDetailInputVATInvoice
Content:
declare @count int
select @count = count(*) from
#IF $f46.NewValue <> $f46.OldValue #THEN
	@f46
#ELSE
	f46$$partition$previous where stt_rec = @stt_rec
#END

if @count > 0 begin
	declare @verifyTaxCode varchar(32), @verifyCustomer varchar(32), @percent varchar(32)
	select @percent = char(37) + 's'
	select @verifyTaxCode = b.ma_so_thue, @verifyCustomer = b.ma_kh from dmtknh a join dmnh b on a.ma_nh = b.ma_nh where a.tk = @tk and (a.ma_dvcs = '' or (a.ma_dvcs = @ma_dvcs and @@action = 'Edit') or (a.ma_dvcs = @@unit and @@action = 'New'))
	if @verifyTaxCode is null or isnull(@verifyCustomer, '') = '' begin
		select 'tk' as field, @$accountConflict as message
		return
	end
	if exists(select 1 from options where name = 'm_kthd_tdv' and val = '1') begin
		declare @verifyInvoice varchar(128), @verifyText varchar(128), @verifyIDNumber varchar(32)
		select @verifyIDNumber = case when @@action = 'New' then '' else @stt_rec end
		select @verifyInvoice = so_ct0, @verifyText = convert(varchar(8), ngay_ct0, 112) +  rtrim(ltrim(so_seri0)) + char(255) + rtrim(ltrim(so_ct0)) from (select top 1 a.ngay_ct0, a.so_seri0, a.so_ct0 from @f46 a join ctgt30 b with (index(c)) on a.ngay_ct0 = b.ngay_ct0 and a.so_seri0 = b.so_seri0 and a.so_ct0 = b.so_ct0 where b.ma_so_thue = @verifyTaxCode and b.stt_rec <> @verifyIDNumber) a
		if isnull(@verifyInvoice, '') <> '' begin
			select '' as field, replace(@$verifyMessage, @percent, rtrim(@verifyInvoice)) as message, 'verify$InputVAT$InvoiceNumber(this, "' + replace(replace(isnull(@verifyText, ''), '\', '\\'), '"', '\"') + '", "f46");' as script
			return
		end
	end
end

Name: CommandCheckChargeInsert
Content:
declare @r int, @field varchar(33), @fieldLabel nvarchar(128)
if @loai_ct in ('1', '2') begin
	if @loai_ct = 1 begin
		select @r = min(line_nbr), @field = 'tk_du' from @f46 a where exists(select 1 from dmtk b where a.tk_du = b.tk and b.tk_cn = 1) and tk_du <> ''
		if @r is null begin
			select @r = min(line_nbr), @field = 'hd_ln' from @f46 a where (tk_du <> '' and hd_ln <> 0) or (not(hd_ln between 1 and (select count(*) from @d46)) and hd_ln <> 0) or (tk_du = '' and hd_ln = 0)
		end
	end

	if @r is null and exists(select 1 from options where name = 'm_ma_nt0' and rtrim(val) <> @ma_nt) begin
		select @r = min(line_nbr), @field = 'ty_gia' from @f46 where tk_du = '' and ty_gia <> 0
	end
	&CommandCheckCharge;
end

Name: CommandCheckCharge
Content:
if @r is not null begin
	select @fieldLabel = case
			when @@language = 'V' then case
				when @field = 'tk_du' then N'Tk đối ứng'
				when @field = 'ty_gia' then N'Tỷ giá gs'
				when @field = 'hd_ln' then N'Stt hóa đơn'
			end
			else case
				when @field = 'tk_du' then N'Ref. Account'
				when @field = 'ty_gia' then N'Book Exchange Rate'
				when @field = 'hd_ln' then N'Line Number'
			end
	end
	select '' as field, replace(@$chargeMessage, '%s', @fieldLabel) as message, 'focusErrorCharge(this,"f46", "' + @field + '", ' + rtrim(@r) + ');' as script
	return
end

if @loai_ct = '1' begin
	declare @bc char(3)
	select @bc = val from options where name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	select top 1 @r = line_nbr from
	#IF $f46.NewValue <> $f46.OldValue #THEN
		@f46 where tk_du = ''
	#ELSE
		f46$$partition$previous where stt_rec = @stt_rec and tk_du = ''
	#END
	order by line_nbr
	if @r is not null and exists(
		select 1 from
		#IF $d46.NewValue <> $d46.OldValue #THEN
			@d46
		#ELSE
			d46$$partition$previous
		#END
		a join cttt20 b on a.stt_rec_tt = b.stt_rec where @ma_nt <> case when b.ma_nt = '' then @bc else b.ma_nt end
		#IF $d46.NewValue = $d46.OldValue #THEN
			and a.stt_rec = @stt_rec
		#END
	) begin
		select '' as field, case when @@language = 'V' then N'Mã ngoại tệ phí ngân hàng và tài khoản đối ứng khác nhau, không lưu được.' else N'Bank charge entry is not supported in the case of multiple currencies payment.' end as message,
			'focusErrorCharge(this,"f46", "tk_du", ' + rtrim(@r) + ');' as script
		return
	end
end

Name: CalculateBookExchangeRate
Content:
declare @b tinyint, @method numeric(1), @basecurrency char(3), @rate numeric(24, 12), @idNumber varchar(32), @idLine varchar(32), @serialize varchar(8000), @analyze varchar(8000), @n numeric(25, 5)
select @serialize = '', @b = rtrim(val) from options where name = 'm_round_tien'
if exists(select 1 from options where name = 'm_use_2fc' and val = 1) select @basecurrency = val from options where name = 'r_ma_nt1'
	else select @basecurrency = val from options where name = 'm_ma_nt0'

if @ma_nt = @basecurrency and @loai_ct = '2' begin
	update d46$$partition$current set tien = tien_nt where stt_rec = @stt_rec
	update @@prime$partition$current set t_tien = t_tien_nt where stt_rec = @stt_rec
end

if @ma_nt <> @basecurrency and (@loai_ct = '2' or @loai_ct = '9')
	update d46$$partition$current set tt_qd = tien_nt, stt_rec_tt = '' where stt_rec = @stt_rec

if (@ma_nt <> @basecurrency and @sua_tg_yn = 0) begin
	select @idNumber = case when @@action = 'New' then '' else @stt_rec end from @@prime$partition$current where stt_rec = @stt_rec
	if @loai_ct = '2' begin
		declare cr cursor for select tk_co, tien_nt, stt_rec0 from d46$$partition$current where stt_rec = @stt_rec order by line_nbr
		declare @tk_co varchar(33), @tien_nt numeric(19, 2)
		open cr
		fetch next from cr into @tk_co, @tien_nt, @idLine
		while @@fetch_status = 0 begin
			select @method = loai_cl_co from dmtk where tk = @tk_co
			if @method <> 2 begin
				exec fs_GetERD @tk_co, @Method, 1, @ngay_ct, @ma_kh, @ma_dvcs, @idNumber, @tien_nt, @so_ct, 1, @rate output
				select @serialize = @serialize + case when @serialize = '' then '' else ';' end + rtrim(@rate)

				update d46$$partition$current set ty_gia_ht2 = @rate, tien = round(tien_nt*@rate, @b) where stt_rec = @stt_rec and stt_rec0 = @idLine
			end else begin
				select @rate = 0
				select @serialize = @serialize + case when @serialize = '' then '' else ';' end + '0:0'
			end

			fetch next from cr into @tk_co, @tien_nt, @idLine
		end
		close cr
		deallocate cr
	end

	select @n = sum(tien) from d46$$partition$current where stt_rec = @stt_rec
	update @@prime$partition$current set t_tien = @n where stt_rec = @stt_rec
end
select @analyze = ''
if (@ma_nt <> @basecurrency and @sua_tg_yn = 0) begin
	if @loai_ct in ('1', '2') begin
		declare crBank cursor for select tk_du, tien_cp_nt, stt_rec0 from f46$$partition$current where stt_rec = @stt_rec order by line_nbr
		declare @$tk_du varchar(33), @tien_cp_nt numeric(19, 2)
		select tk, round(t_tien_nt*ty_gia, @b) as ps, t_tien_nt as ps_nt into #erd from @@prime$partition$current where stt_rec = @stt_rec
		open crBank
		fetch next from crBank into @$tk_du, @tien_cp_nt, @idLine
		while @@fetch_status = 0 begin
			select @method = loai_cl_co from dmtk where tk = @$tk_du
			if @method <> 2 begin
				exec fs_GetERD @$tk_du, @Method, 1, @ngay_ct, @ma_kh, @ma_dvcs, @idNumber, @tien_cp_nt, @so_ct, 1, @rate output, '#erd'
				select @analyze = @analyze + case when @analyze = '' then '' else ';' end + rtrim(@rate)

				update f46$$partition$current set ty_gia = @rate where stt_rec = @stt_rec and stt_rec0 = @idLine
			end else begin
				select @rate = 0
				select @analyze = @analyze + case when @analyze = '' then '' else ';' end + '0:0'
			end

			fetch next from crBank into @$tk_du, @tien_cp_nt, @idLine
		end
		close crBank
		deallocate crBank
	end
end

Name: Post
Content:
declare @group nvarchar(128)
select @group = rtrim(groupby) from @@sysDatabaseName..voucherinfo where ma_ct = @@id

if @loai_ct <> '3' begin
	update d46$$partition$current set ma_kh_i = '' where stt_rec = @stt_rec
end

if @status <> '0' begin
	if @status = '1' begin
		insert into p00$000000 select stt_rec, ma_dvcs, ma_ct, ngay_ct, so_ct, t_tien_nt, t_tien, ma_nt, ty_gia, dien_giai, datetime2, user_id2 from @@prime$partition$current where stt_rec = @stt_rec
		exec fs_PostCRTran 'm46$$partition$current', 'd46$$partition$current', @stt_rec, @group, 1, null, 1
	end else begin
		exec fs_PostCRTran 'm46$$partition$current', 'd46$$partition$current', @stt_rec, @group, 2, null, 1
		exec fs20_AfterUpdateGL @stt_rec, 'm46$$partition$current', 'd46$$partition$current', @@id, @@userID
		insert into r00$$partition$current select * from ct00 where stt_rec = @stt_rec
	end

	if @loai_ct <> '1' begin
		create table #extmp(stt_rec char(13), stt_rec0 char(3), tk_co varchar(32), tien numeric(32, 12), tien_nt numeric(32, 12))
		create table #ex(stt_rec char(13), stt_rec0 char(3), tk_co varchar(32), tien numeric(32, 12), tien_nt numeric(32, 12), i int identity(1, 1))

		insert into #extmp select max(stt_rec), min(stt_rec0), a.tk_co, sum(a.tien), sum(a.tien_nt) from d46$$partition$current a join dmtk b on a.tk_co = b.tk where a.stt_rec = @stt_rec and b.tk_cn = 1 group by a.ma_kh_i, a.tk_co
		insert into #extmp select max(stt_rec), min(stt_rec0), a.tk_du, /*
			sum(a.tien_cp + a.t_thue)
		*/ round(sum(a.tien_cp_nt * a.ty_gia + a.t_thue_nt * a.ty_gia), @b), sum(a.tien_cp_nt + a.t_thue_nt) from f46$$partition$current a join dmtk b on a.tk_du = b.tk where a.stt_rec = @stt_rec and b.tk_cn = 1 group by a.tk_du

		insert into #ex select max(stt_rec), min(stt_rec0), tk_co, sum(tien), sum(tien_nt) from #extmp group by tk_co
		update #ex set stt_rec0 = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Voucher$GetRecordsGroup(i)

		exec FastBusiness$Posting$Allocation @@id, @loai_ct, 'm46$$partition$current', 'd46$$partition$current', 't_tien_nt', 't_tien', 'tien_nt', 'tien', 'cttt50', @stt_rec, 'ma_kh_i', '', '#ex', 'tk_co'
	end
end

	select top 0 line_nbr, tk_du, ty_gia, hd_ln into #checkcharge from @f46
	if $f46.NewValue <> $f46.OldValue begin
		insert into #checkcharge select line_nbr, tk_du, ty_gia, hd_ln from @f46
	end else begin
		insert into #checkcharge select line_nbr, tk_du, ty_gia, hd_ln from f46$$partition$current where stt_rec = @stt_rec
	end

	if @loai_ct = 1 begin
		select @r = min(line_nbr), @field = 'tk_du' from #checkcharge a where exists(select 1 from dmtk b where a.tk_du = b.tk and b.tk_cn = 1) and tk_du <> ''
		if @r is null begin
			if $d46.NewValue <> $d46.OldValue begin
				select @r = min(line_nbr), @field = 'hd_ln' from #checkcharge a where (tk_du <> '' and hd_ln <> 0) or (not(hd_ln between 1 and (select count(*) from @d46)) and hd_ln <> 0) or (tk_du = '' and hd_ln = 0)
			end else begin
				select @r = min(line_nbr), @field = 'hd_ln' from #checkcharge a where (tk_du <> '' and hd_ln <> 0) or (not(hd_ln between 1 and (select count(*) from d46$$partition$current where stt_rec = @stt_rec)) and hd_ln <> 0) or (tk_du = '' and hd_ln = 0)
			end
		end
	end

	if @r is null and exists(select 1 from options where name = 'm_ma_nt0' and rtrim(val) <> @ma_nt)begin
		select @r = min(line_nbr), @field = 'ty_gia' from #checkcharge where tk_du = '' and ty_gia <> 0
	end

	&CommandCheckCharge;
end

if @r is not null begin
	select @fieldLabel = case
			when @@language = 'V' then case
				when @field = 'tk_du' then N'Tk đối ứng'
				when @field = 'ty_gia' then N'Tỷ giá gs'
				when @field = 'hd_ln' then N'Stt hóa đơn'
			end
			else case
				when @field = 'tk_du' then N'Ref. Account'
				when @field = 'ty_gia' then N'Book Exchange Rate'
				when @field = 'hd_ln' then N'Line Number'
			end
	end
	select '' as field, replace(@$chargeMessage, '%s', @fieldLabel) as message, 'focusErrorCharge(this,"f46", "' + @field + '", ' + rtrim(@r) + ');' as script
	return
end

if @loai_ct = '1' begin
	declare @bc char(3)
	select @bc = val from options where name = 'm_ma_nt0'
	select top 1 @r = line_nbr from
	#IF $f46.NewValue <> $f46.OldValue #THEN
		@f46 where tk_du = ''
	#ELSE
		f46$$partition$previous where stt_rec = @stt_rec and tk_du = ''

	order by line_nbr
	if @r is not null and exists(

			d46$$partition$previous
		#END
		a join cttt20 b on a.stt_rec_tt = b.stt_rec where @ma_nt <> case when b.ma_nt = '' then @bc else b.ma_nt end

Name: CalculateBookExchangeRate
Content:
declare @b tinyint, @method numeric(1), @basecurrency char(3), @rate numeric(24, 12), @idNumber varchar(32), @idLine varchar(32), @serialize varchar(8000), @analyze varchar(8000), @n numeric(25, 5)
select @serialize = '', @b = rtrim(val) from options where name = 'm_round_tien'
if exists(select 1 from options where name = 'm_use_2fc' and val = 1) select @basecurrency = val from options where name = 'r_ma_nt1'
	else select @basecurrency = val from options where name = 'm_ma_nt0'

if @ma_nt = @basecurrency and @loai_ct = '2' begin
	update d46$$partition$current set tien = tien_nt where stt_rec = @stt_rec
	update @@prime$partition$current set t_tien = t_tien_nt where stt_rec = @stt_rec
end

if @ma_nt <> @basecurrency and (@loai_ct = '2' or @loai_ct = '9')
	update d46$$partition$current set tt_qd = tien_nt, stt_rec_tt = '' where stt_rec = @stt_rec

if (@ma_nt <> @basecurrency and @sua_tg_yn = 0) begin
	select @idNumber = case when @@action = 'New' then '' else @stt_rec end from @@prime$partition$current where stt_rec = @stt_rec
	if @loai_ct = '2' begin
		declare cr cursor for select tk_co, tien_nt, stt_rec0 from d46$$partition$current where stt_rec = @stt_rec order by line_nbr
		declare @tk_co varchar(33), @tien_nt numeric(19, 2)
		open cr
		fetch next from cr into @tk_co, @tien_nt, @idLine
		while @@fetch_status = 0 begin
			select @method = loai_cl_co from dmtk where tk = @tk_co
			if @method <> 2 begin
				exec fs_GetERD @tk_co, @Method, 1, @ngay_ct, @ma_kh, @ma_dvcs, @idNumber, @tien_nt, @so_ct, 1, @rate output
				select @serialize = @serialize + case when @serialize = '' then '' else ';' end + rtrim(@rate)

				update d46$$partition$current set ty_gia_ht2 = @rate, tien = round(tien_nt*@rate, @b) where stt_rec = @stt_rec and stt_rec0 = @idLine
			end else begin
				select @rate = 0
				select @serialize = @serialize + case when @serialize = '' then '' else ';' end + '0:0'
			end

			fetch next from cr into @tk_co, @tien_nt, @idLine
		end
		close cr
		deallocate cr
	end

	select @n = sum(tien) from d46$$partition$current where stt_rec = @stt_rec
	update @@prime$partition$current set t_tien = @n where stt_rec = @stt_rec
end
select @analyze = ''
if (@ma_nt <> @basecurrency and @sua_tg_yn = 0) begin
	if @loai_ct in ('1', '2') begin
		declare crBank cursor for select tk_du, tien_cp_nt, stt_rec0 from f46$$partition$current where stt_rec = @stt_rec order by line_nbr
		declare @$tk_du varchar(33), @tien_cp_nt numeric(19, 2)
		select tk, round(t_tien_nt*ty_gia, @b) as ps, t_tien_nt as ps_nt into #erd from @@prime$partition$current where stt_rec = @stt_rec
		open crBank
		fetch next from crBank into @$tk_du, @tien_cp_nt, @idLine
		while @@fetch_status = 0 begin
			select @method = loai_cl_co from dmtk where tk = @$tk_du
			if @method <> 2 begin
				exec fs_GetERD @$tk_du, @Method, 1, @ngay_ct, @ma_kh, @ma_dvcs, @idNumber, @tien_cp_nt, @so_ct, 1, @rate output, '#erd'
				select @analyze = @analyze + case when @analyze = '' then '' else ';' end + rtrim(@rate)

				update f46$$partition$current set ty_gia = @rate where stt_rec = @stt_rec and stt_rec0 = @idLine
			end else begin
				select @rate = 0
				select @analyze = @analyze + case when @analyze = '' then '' else ';' end + '0:0'
			end

			fetch next from crBank into @$tk_du, @tien_cp_nt, @idLine
		end
		close crBank
		deallocate crBank
	end
end

Name: Post
Content:
declare @group nvarchar(128)
select @group = rtrim(groupby) from @@sysDatabaseName..voucherinfo where ma_ct = @@id

if @loai_ct <> '3' begin
	update d46$$partition$current set ma_kh_i = '' where stt_rec = @stt_rec
end

if @status <> '0' begin
	if @status = '1' begin
		insert into p00$000000 select stt_rec, ma_dvcs, ma_ct, ngay_ct, so_ct, t_tien_nt, t_tien, ma_nt, ty_gia, dien_giai, datetime2, user_id2 from @@prime$partition$current where stt_rec = @stt_rec
		exec fs_PostCRTran 'm46$$partition$current', 'd46$$partition$current', @stt_rec, @group, 1, null, 1
	end else begin
		exec fs_PostCRTran 'm46$$partition$current', 'd46$$partition$current', @stt_rec, @group, 2, null, 1
		exec fs20_AfterUpdateGL @stt_rec, 'm46$$partition$current', 'd46$$partition$current', @@id, @@userID
		insert into r00$$partition$current select * from ct00 where stt_rec = @stt_rec
	end

	if @loai_ct <> '1' begin
		create table #extmp(stt_rec char(13), stt_rec0 char(3), tk_co varchar(32), tien numeric(32, 12), tien_nt numeric(32, 12))
		create table #ex(stt_rec char(13), stt_rec0 char(3), tk_co varchar(32), tien numeric(32, 12), tien_nt numeric(32, 12), i int identity(1, 1))

		insert into #extmp select max(stt_rec), min(stt_rec0), a.tk_co, sum(a.tien), sum(a.tien_nt) from d46$$partition$current a join dmtk b on a.tk_co = b.tk where a.stt_rec = @stt_rec and b.tk_cn = 1 group by a.ma_kh_i, a.tk_co
		insert into #extmp select max(stt_rec), min(stt_rec0), a.tk_du, /*
			sum(a.tien_cp + a.t_thue)
		*/ round(sum(a.tien_cp_nt * a.ty_gia + a.t_thue_nt * a.ty_gia), @b), sum(a.tien_cp_nt + a.t_thue_nt) from f46$$partition$current a join dmtk b on a.tk_du = b.tk where a.stt_rec = @stt_rec and b.tk_cn = 1 group by a.tk_du

		insert into #ex select max(stt_rec), min(stt_rec0), tk_co, sum(tien), sum(tien_nt) from #extmp group by tk_co
		update #ex set stt_rec0 = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Voucher$GetRecordsGroup(i)

		exec FastBusiness$Posting$Allocation @@id, @loai_ct, 'm46$$partition$current', 'd46$$partition$current', 't_tien_nt', 't_tien', 'tien_nt', 'tien', 'cttt50', @stt_rec, 'ma_kh_i', '', '#ex', 'tk_co'
	end
end

function verify$InputVAT$InvoiceNumber(f, s, force) {
  var c = String.fromCharCode(255), name = force ? force : 'r30', z = f.getItem(name)._controlBehavior, l0 = z._getColumnOrder('ngay_ct0'), l1 = force ? -1 : z._getColumnOrder('ma_so_thue'), l2 = z._getColumnOrder('so_seri0'), l3 = z._getColumnOrder('so_ct0');
  f._errorWarningObject = null;
  for (var i = 0; i < z._rowCount; i++) {
    var row = i + 1;
    if ($func.formatDateOrder(z._getItemValue(row, l0)) + (force ? '' : $func.trim(z._getItemValue(row, l1)) + c) + $func.trim(z._getItemValue(row, l2)) + c + $func.trim(z._getItemValue(row, l3)) == s) {
      f._errorWarningObject = z._getItem(row, l3);
      break;
    }
  }
  if (f._errorWarningObject) {
    f.focus(name);
    f._errorWarningObject.focus();
  }
}
